title: The held-out answer-rate test refuses a held-out row that rewords a tuned eval row
goal: rag.py eval with --file on the held-out file (or a check the held-out run makes) fails, naming the row pair, when a held-out row shares its expected article with a lookup_eval.csv or doc2query expansion row and most of its words, so a reworded tuned question cannot lift the held-out rate; one planted-failure test within the ceiling proves it. It answers SP-4rq725fe, where the goal clause none of which is a lookup_eval.csv row was read only as exact text, no check read it, and HO-session-id-bash-env (a rewording of EV-claude-code-expose-session-id-bash) passed into the file (BG-4wqn6kog).
notes: Blocks the held-out answer rate fitness test of EP-gzr4mmkm: without it a reworded tuned question can lift the measured rate (BG-4wqn6kog).
